reasons.plausibility: Graphite and MoS2 oxidize or degrade well below 800 °C in air, so they cannot provide lubrication across the full temperature range as proposed.
reasons.testability: The proposed pin-on-disk test with friction and wear measurements is clear and feasible, but the falsification criterion is weak because it does not specify the temperature range over which the reduction must be maintained.
reasons.usefulness: The hypothesis is too generic and ignores the known high-temperature limitations of the suggested lubricants, so it does not offer a viable path for a researcher working on this problem.
